# `aitbc dispute resolve`

Rule on a disputed job payment (operator or arbiter only). A refund that settles also slashes the provider bond, so this moves money in both directions and cannot be undone from the CLI.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dispute resolve [OPTIONS] JOB_ID
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | text | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--outcome` | choice | — | yes | Whether the escrow returns to the buyer (refund) or pays the provider (release). |
| `--reason` | text | — | yes | The ruling, recorded on the settlement (1-500 characters). |
| `--yes` | flag | `false` | no | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dispute resolve --outcome <outcome> --reason <reason> JOB_ID
```
